public_sources.title: Current judicial change-sale republication - Chengdu Qingyang Guanghua Beisan Road 98 basement unit -115
bound_facts: Property certificate: 川（2020）成都市不动产权第0389990号.
Existing lease runs through 2030-11-20 at RMB 3,000/month and post-auction rent is payable by the tenant to the buyer.
Transfer eligibility is not guaranteed by the notice and must be independently checked by the buyer.
Historical unpaid water, electricity, gas and property-management charges attach as buyer-side diligence/exposure.
Seller-side transfer taxes must be advanced by the buyer during transfer and reclaimed from the court against tax receipts within the stated post-ruling window.
If the tenant leaves at lease expiry and does not renew, the buyer must first refund the lease deposit and then pursue the executed owner for recovery.
Public viewing reservation closed on 2026-09-09; the page provides an auction-assistance consultation channel but no further public ledger.
